يترايقوا (form VI)
# يَتَرَايَقُوا (yatarāyaqū) /ja.ta.raː.ja.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَرَايَقَ (tarāyaqa)
# يُتَرَايَقُوا (yutarāyaqū) /ju.ta.raː.ja.quː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَرَايَقَ (tarāyaqa)
